decisionsTitle: «Numele meu apare la „Cine vine”»: a person shows or hides their name on a «Vin!» answer at any time
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19 14:35:** «De asemenea, aș vrea ca oamenii să poată ușor să zică „afișează / ascunde” numele meu public.» For a registration this has existed since §186 (three doors, one write, the link read and not spent because the choice is reversible and low-stakes, audited without the name). For a «Vin!» answer (§812) the tick «Vreau să apar cu numele» was offered only at the moment of answering. This gives «Vin!» the same reversible switch, amending §812.

**Decision.**

1. **One service, `setRsvpShowName(db, eventId, who, { showName, displayName?, defaultName? }, now)`** in `rsvp.ts`. `who` is a verified identity (`remembered` or `account`, asserted verified and consistent like `withdrawRsvp`) or `{ token }` — an `RSVP_WITHDRAW` link, **read and not spent**, live only while it is unused, not replaced, not expired and its event has not started, and only for the event it names. Only a **confirmed** row of that person is touched; none → the reason `none` and nothing is written. **ON** needs a name, and it is **the one posted now** (`cleanDisplayName`: trimmed, at most 80) — or, only when the row holds none, `defaultName` (the signed-in account's own, offered only for the tick) — else the reason `name`. A name already on the row is never published unposted: it may be one a stranger typed on the page with the tick off (§812: an unconfirmed row never lends a stranger's typed name to a verified press), so every door shows it — the box «Numele tău» prefilled and editable, the help «Cu bifa apari ca „…”» — and posts it; it needs the event to take «Vin!» now (`rsvpOffered`: published, ahead, ticked, the notice describing «Vin!»), else `closed`; and it **records the privacy notice in force** on the row (`privacy_notice_version`): the tick is a fresh consent under the notice that describes it. **OFF** clears `show_name` and **keeps the name stored** (the person's, used again if they tick it back on), needs no notice and no open event: a person may always stop being named. The public cache is told once (`places`), only when something changed. No audit row: nothing here is something the staff did, and §186's «without the name» holds trivially.

2. **Three doors, one tick «Numele meu apare la „Cine vine”»** — a real tick box, never a toggle button. (a) **The remembered browser:** on «Tu vii ✓» in `RsvpRemembered`, a checkbox in its own small form that saves at once (a change submits it) through `rsvpShowNameAction`, which reads the `httpOnly` cookie; ticking with no stored name opens one «Numele tău» box and «Salvează». The island's state gains `showName` (the tick AND a name: a tick with no name shows nothing and is drawn unticked in all three doors) and `name` (the answer's own, handed only to the browser whose `httpOnly` cookie proves it is the person's, never the address) — and the island's new props (labels, the action) travel from `RsvpBox`, because an island that imported the action would take its chain into a visitor's bundle (§489). (b) **The members' zone:** the same tick, with «Salvează», on the «Tu vii ✓» row of «Alergări» (`setNameAsMemberAction`, the account read from the session; `answeredByAccount` now returns each answered event's `showName` and `name`); the account's own name is the fallback ONLY when ticking and only when the row has none (§812's rule: a stale tab cannot swap a typed name for the one an Administrator typed in «Echipa»); the box «Numele tău» when the row holds a name (prefilled) or neither the row nor the account has one. The outcomes are four more `?vin=` codes (`shown`, `hidden`, `name`, `none`) with the event page's own sentences; a refusal lands on the sentence, a success on the row. (c) **The «Nu mai vin» link's page** (`/vin/<token>`): for a live `RSVP_WITHDRAW` link of a counted answer only, the page opens neutral («Răspunsul tău», «Vii la {event}.»), then the same tick in its own small POST (`setNameByLinkAction`), then «Nu mai vii la {event}? Răspunsul tău se șterge.» directly above «Nu mai vin» — the page has two jobs, and the sentence about deleting stands next to the button it explains. **That POST does not spend the link** — the §186 precedent for a reversible, low-stakes choice — so «Nu mai vin» still works from the same page afterwards, ; the GET still writes nothing (BR-REQ-036-02) and draws the new state and one sentence from `?nume=` — «Gata: numele tău apare» only while the row says it does, never from the address alone. **The flips have their own throttle**, `rsvp-name` (thirty an hour, keyed on the link's hash), not `token-validate`'s ten that «Nu mai vin» and every GET of the page spend: a flip is a POST plus the redirect's GET, so charged to `token-validate` five flips in an hour would have locked «Nu mai vin» out of its own link. The redirect's GET is paid back (`refundRateLimit`), and a refused flip says so on the page (`?nume=wait`) and leaves the link working. A spent, expired or unknown link, and the «Vii?» email's unanswered question, have no tick.

3. **Authorization is on the server** (BR-REQ-060-01): the cookie, the session or the token says who; no address and no row id is ever read from a form.

4. **The «Vin!» confirmation and the «Vii?» email** say, under their «Nu vin» button, when the line is true — «După „Da, vin”, tot din „Nu vin” îți arăți sau ascunzi numele; răspunsul se șterge doar dacă apeși „Nu mai vin” pe pagina lui» — because the tick is drawn only for a counted answer and the body above says «Nu vin» deletes it; the «counted» shape, whose one button is the withdraw link, says it in its body («Pe pagina butonului îți arăți sau ascunzi numele…»). The privacy notice's `{{rsvp}}` paragraph says the name is withdrawn by unticking it in the recognised browser, the members' zone or the link's page, and that a hidden name stays in the answer, not public.

5. **For the lawyer** (`SETUP.md` §46): the sentence «Debifat, numele rămâne în răspuns, dar nu mai apare public» — whether a name may stay stored after the consent to show it is withdrawn (GDPR art. 17(1)(b)) — is read before the notice from the new template is approved; the behaviour (OFF keeps the name, so ticking again brings it back) is the owner's brief, and a name typed on the page with the tick off is kept the same way today.

6. **Lands in the same batch as `feat/who-comes-visible`**, which names the list «Cine vine» that the tick's label points at; until then the page's heading is «Vin ({count})».

**Refused.** A toggle-glyph button (the owner, 2026-10-14). A switch that spends the withdraw link (the person would lose «Nu mai vin» by changing a name). Showing a name stored under a notice that does not describe it. An audit row for a person's own tick on a non-registration. A line in the «withdraw» stage of the confirmation email (the person asked to leave; its one button is the withdraw link). Publishing a stored name without showing it. Charging the flips to the bucket «Nu mai vin» depends on.
changelogLine: - **«Numele meu apare la „Cine vine”»** — anyone who said «Vin» can show or hide their name on the list at any time, from the page (remembered browser), from the members' zone's «Alergări», or from the page of the email's «Nu mai vin» link (which the tick does not spend); the confirmation email says so under «Nu vin». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a confirmed «Vin!» answer, when its person ticks or unticks «Numele meu apare la „Cine vine”» — in the remembered browser, in the members' zone or on the «Nu mai vin» link's page — then unticking hides the name from the public list at once and keeps it stored, and ticking shows it at once only with a name (the name posted now — every door shows the answer's own stored name in a prefilled box, so none is published unseen — or the signed-in account's own when the answer holds none), only while the event takes «Vin!» and the notice in force describes it, recording that notice's version on the row; an unconfirmed or unknown answer is never touched and says so in a sentence (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a live «Nu mai vin» link of a counted «Vin!» answer, when its page's name tick is pressed, then the POST reads the link and does not spend it — the same link still takes the answer back afterwards — the GET of the page writes nothing, and the flips spend their own throttle, never the attempts «Nu mai vin» depends on; and a spent, replaced, expired or unknown link, or an event that has started, shows no tick and changes nothing (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: anyone who said «Vin» can show or hide their name on «Cine vine» at any time, from the page, the zone or the email's link
